charge.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
charge.translation: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.

charge.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
charge.translation: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.

dadyy.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
verses.translation: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task
And say, 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'
